status: proposed C1 normative definition; independent review pending; no implementation
profileIdDomain: ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63}$; exact member of selected owner profiles; identical to six staged C1 propertyNames domains, case-sensitive, no trimming/coercion
instanceIdDomain: nonempty string length1..128, no leading/trailing whitespace; exact supplied installed/service identity, not auto-derived or a grant
selectionRule: Exact supplied role/owner/instanceId must match exactly one binding; select complete named profile, never first, never default, never keywise merge
schemaValidationRule: Every owner file and every declared profile must validate at its staged complete owner schema; then selected cross-owner/role/instance relations must validate; no defaults or coercion injected
referencesRule: Only six fixed components/<owner>.config.json relative paths; no arbitrary includes, absolute paths, dot components, escape, symlink traversal or old filename fallback

locator.class: explicit transport locator only, never settings values

publication: Validate all root, owner, profile and relation objects and captured source identities before generating one immutable complete root+components directory tree. Both Charts and all consuming images read that identical generation; generated copies have no editable authority. Preserve no-follow/regular-file/stat-drift/freeze properties. Bundle identity includes each relative path and SHA256 and selected binding tuple/profile; do not silently hash basename-only files after adding a subdirectory.
activation: C1 service/process startup only, explicit selected profile; no live module reload. C5 will persist run/module bindings; no current module implementation claimed.
recovery: Existing historical v2 runs retain original archived v2 reader/package closure and cannot be read as v3 by defaults. New v3 starts do not search old author files; missing historical closure rejects rather than Latest. External secret revision identity remains separate.
selectionRefSupersession: Original prospective #/components/<owner>/profile references are preserved historical contracts. Active C1 selection is #/bindings/<exact-matching-role-owner-instance-index>/profileId; same physical owner profiles object is selected by that explicit tuple, not both mechanisms.
